title: Wayward
overview: A medieval tavern sandbox where your wife has a mind of her own. You and your wife run a medieval tavern. The story is unwritten — nothing about how it goes is decided before you play it. Sandbox simulation · NTR / NTS

title: Malon: Ballad of the Ranch
overview: Overview: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake fan game is ready. You arrive at Lon Lon Ranch for a trial week. Seven days to earn Ingo’s trust… and to win over Malon : grown-up, warm, curious, a little lonely, and very good at teasing you.

title: Altera Via
language: English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French, Italian, German, Russian, Turkish, Polish, Indonesian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
overview: Altera Via is an adult-oriented, story-driven visual novel focused on romance, relationships, and character development. Step into the life of a young man as he navigates friendships, unexpected encounters, and growing feelings for the people around him. Each character has her own personality, background, and personal struggles. Through everyday interactions and meaningful choices, relationships gradually develop into something more. What begins as an ordinary chapter of his life may lead him down a very different path.

title: Dirty Mop
overview: Years ago, your father was the janitor of this very building — until a mysterious incident, quietly swept under the rug, made him disappear without a trace. No police report. No witnesses. No goodbye. Now you’ve taken his old job. Same building. Same uniform. Same master key. But finding the truth means getting close.

title: Tyr’ma
overview: Tyr’ma is an adult role-playing game set in a massive open-world. With a focus on gameplay first, and kinky stuff second, we want the game to feel like a genuine experience that just happens, to have the ability to have some more adult fun on the side.

title: BreedVille
overview: Breedville is the ultimate breeding management game! When Russell takes over his father’s estate, he uncovers a intoxicating world hidden beyond the treeline—a sanctuary of seductive woodland entities craving new desires and exotic beasts. Cultivate lush harvests, master the delicate art of creature breeding, and indulge in deep physical pleasures with wild companions. Use your growing fortune and mythical indulgences to outwit the corrupt Sheriff, defy his ruthless tax demands, and strip him of his power.

title: SniperGirls
overview: Sniper Girls is an adult visual novel where you play as Oscar, navigating complex relationships with the women in his building. Choices matter and every interaction has consequences.

title: Wasteland Lewdness
overview: In this tortured world, nuclear bombs didn’t just take more than half of the human population away, they also burned all the humanity from those who survived… You are a young man who has never ventured beyond your safe settlement until now. Forced to leave your home and into the wastes — where almost everything tries to kill you, and the rest wants to do things far worse — on a tech-scavenge quest.

title: Ore no Taisetsu na Osananajimi to Nikuki Kuso Oyaji
overview: The main character, Takuma, lost his mother when he was young. There was someone standing in the kitchen in my mother’s place. It was Fumi, my childhood friend who lives next door to me. A homely and tolerant girl who is sometimes meddlesome, but always worries about Takuma. She was such an important person to Takuma that it filled him with the sadness of losing his mother.

title: Chronicles of Hell and Heaven
overview: Hi guys, my name is Kazuki. I’m an amateur writer. I am writing a book of adult short stories. Come to visit me at my home, and I will read one of my stories to you.

title: Pinked and Owned
overview: Pinked and Owned is an adult HTML/browser narrative game about slow feminization and a life quietly rearranging itself. You play a guy with a small chastity cage, a complicated roommate, and the kind of job that keeps asking him to wear something new. Stat-driven sandbox, explore the city, build (or lose) your resolve, and watch the story branch based on choices you didn’t even realise were choices. Active solo dev, new content every 2-3 weeks.

title: Eroded Twins - The Downfall of the Empire
overview: Long ago, a war between humans and demons ravaged the continent until the Demon King was sealed away, bringing an end to the conflict. Now, three nations coexist in relative peace: the law-bound Celestia Empire, the commerce-driven Mercant Duchy, and the demon-inhabited region of Necrosia. At the heart of these territories lies the Kingdom of Edelwald, where a princess must risk everything to protect her kingdom.

title: Netorase Wife Training ~Letting Another Man Hold Her, Making Her Fall with My Fingers~
overview: You, the husband, will personally persuade your initially reluctant wife, Kasumi, to become involved with another man. Over twenty days, you send her out, await her return, and gradually reshape your once-harmonious marriage through your own actions. The game emphasizes the wife's perspective, interactive touch-based H-scenes, and the slow psychological deterioration of everyday married life.

title: Spellbound Command
overview: Build an army, bind heroes, increase bonds, and destroy the enemy. Spellbound Command combines tactical RTS with dating simulations and detailed visual novels.

title: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
overview: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

title: ERO FIGHTERS
overview: Do you have a favorite adult manga theme?! You play as a self-proclaimed adult manga collector who, for some mysterious reason, is given the chance to challenge the characters from his beloved manga. Defeat them one by one and turn your fantasies into reality!

title: OnlyRifts
overview: Rifts open into hundreds of worlds, and behind each one there's a girl. You manage them, and the first one through is Juno, a catgirl streamer from Neon City. On stream, chat tips her for requests and you pick which ones she does. Push too hard and the platform hands out strikes. Play it too safe and her viewers drift off. Off stream, she's all yours. She video calls you, and every call is a little card game where you read her mood and play your lines. She texts you and sends selfies. She tries on outfits for you, drags you out on dates and lets you learn exactly where she likes to be touched. She's got a card Drop too, and you get a free pull every 12 hours. The closer you get, the further her private shows go. 0.1 is free and has Juno's whole route. More girls and worlds are on the way. Every character is 18+. title: MetF After The Wait
overview: The new game MetF After the Wait is a game in which you play as two characters, Radia and her daughter Kanza , the game is set in the same (city) country as Yasmine Innocence . Both female characters are already corrupted, but in this game, time has passed, and Radia and Kanza have slowed down a lot when it comes to sex, It’s up to you to show them that you can get anything if you know where to put your hands… MetF After the wait , it’s not Chapter 4 , it’s true that it’s the same characters, but time has passed, so let’s just say it’s not quite the same vibe.

title: REBELLIOUN
overview: A living NTR village sandbox that keeps moving even when you look away. Play a humble blacksmith under an occupying gang. Fifteen women, corrupted loyalties, dark secrets, dire consequences, pregnancy. Protect your wife and daughter at all costs... and the rest, if you can.

title: Entropy - The Struggle of Fate
overview: After a failed attack on the Frainnan village, Varnel is promptly captured by the enemy chief. Understanding his role in the ceremony, he makes peace with his fate, only for the chief to spare his life and keep him as a prisoner. For a reason or another, the Frainnan tries to assimilate him in their way of life.

title: Road of a Goddess 2
overview: Explore a stylish early preview of the scenic Las Diosas canals in the first level. Fight off initial enemies along the waterways and unlock new alternative outfits. The second scene traps the girls deep inside a dangerous, late-game mine level. Collect mysterious glowing elements to illuminate the pitch-black areas of the cavern. Test powerful new combat mechanics like the devastating forward-facing Milk Blast. Use Jacquelyn's spinning Sword Blender to shred groups of enemies and cross wide gaps. Execute Montse's heavy three-hit Hammer Combo to trap targets right in their tracks. Touch Montse during the combo to dynamically power up the damage of each strike. Get an exclusive hands-on look at the evolving gameplay, visuals, and tech features.
